verdict.rationale: Fireflies' security page lists a first-party "Rules Engine" described as automation workflows for admins, so the product does offer its own event-driven rules. The only documented scope is meeting access and privacy control, with no detail on triggers, conditions, or actions. Webhooks and the Zapier integration are building blocks or external tools and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented rule definition (triggers, conditions, actions), general-purpose actions beyond access/privacy, availability to non-admin users, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
